params.body:
## Why

`packages/core/models.mjs` carried an agent loop on the Vercel AI SDK that nothing calls: `getAIProvider` has no caller and `generateText` is imported but not used. Its two packages, `ai` and `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`, still had to be installed, kept current and checked on every advisory.

## What

- The unused block in `models.mjs` goes.
- `ai` and `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible` leave `package.json`. The lockfile loses them and the fourteen packages only they brought along. Nothing is added and no other version changes.

## Checked

- No file imports any of the packages that leave.
- Full suite 1821 of 1821, `tsc` clean, `npm audit --omit=dev` finds 0 vulnerabilities.

## After merge

Nothing to run.
params.title: Drop the two AI SDK packages nothing uses
